items.title: Where do we start?
items.text: Start with the result you want, the pages you need, and any existing material. The first conversation should establish whether the fit is right.

items.title: What if the content is not ready?
items.text: Identify the missing pieces early and agree who will supply them. A draft can help shape the page, but it should be reviewed before publication.

items.title: Can the site change later?
items.text: Yes. The modular structure makes it possible to add, remove, or reorder sections as the business develops.

items.title: Is this a real business?
items.text: No. This is a fictional demonstration of the website system. Contact delivery is disabled.
